name: React component
meaning: A function React calls to obtain a description of part of the UI.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: JSX expression
meaning: A JavaScript expression placed inside JSX braces so its value becomes part of the element description.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Props
meaning: Read-only inputs supplied to a React component through its JSX attributes.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Children composition
meaning: Passing nested React content to a wrapper through props.children.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Event handler
meaning: A function supplied to React to run in response to a user event.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: State setter
meaning: A function returned by useState that requests an update to a component’s remembered state.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: State snapshot
meaning: The state values captured by one render and used by its event handlers.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Functional state update
meaning: Passing a pure function to a state setter so React calculates next state from the pending previous state.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Conditional rendering
meaning: Choose a JSX branch from the current props or state.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Data-owned key
meaning: A stable sibling identity taken from the record rather than its current position.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Controlled field
meaning: A field whose displayed value comes from React state or props.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Submit boundary
meaning: One form handler receives submissions and owns the corresponding action.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Object replacement
meaning: Create a new state object instead of modifying the previous one.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Nonmutating removal
meaning: Return a new array of retained records while leaving the old array untouched.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Derived value
meaning: A value calculated from current props or state rather than stored as another synchronized copy.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Pure rendering
meaning: Calculating JSX from current inputs without changing anything outside that calculation.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: DOM ref
meaning: A stable ref object whose current property can hold a committed DOM node.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Effect dependency
meaning: A reactive value read by an Effect whose change requires resynchronization.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Keyed state reset
meaning: Intentionally replacing component identity with a different key to initialize new local state.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Effect replay
meaning: A development-only extra setup/cleanup cycle that helps expose incomplete cleanup.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Memoized calculation
meaning: A pure result that may be reused while its dependency values remain unchanged.
context: React18 browser component behavior; framework and host limits are explicit.

name: Accessible ID link
meaning: A unique identifier connecting an element to its label or descriptive text.
